item.title: Ohio Lawmakers Introduce Bill to Ban NIL for High School Athletes, Aiming to Overrule OHSAA's Decision In Response to Jamier Brown Case
item.description: In November, the OHSAA ruled to allow NIL for Ohio high school athletes following a lawsuit by future Buckeye receiver Jamier Brown. Now, Ohio lawmakers are trying to overrule the OHSAA. The new House Bill 661, sponsored by state representatives Adam Bird and Mike Odioso, seeks to ban middle and high school athletes in the state of Ohio from earning money from their name, image and likeness. item.description: Two former Ohio State players were included in an eight-player trade between the Dallas Mavericks and Washington Wizards on Wednesday.
